name: Side Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel on the floor, sit back onto your heels and stretch your arms forward on the floor, as in child's pose.
Walk both hands toward one side until you feel a stretch along the opposite side of your trunk.
Keep your hips sitting back toward your heels, and do not let the hip on the stretched side lift.
Breathe slowly into the stretched side and hold for the set time.
Walk your hands back through the middle and repeat on the other side.
